name: cloudvault
description: Security-first private file storage and controlled sharing platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @cloudvault/web" "npm run dev -w @cloudvault/api" "npm run dev -w @cloudvault/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloudvault/api && npm run build -w @cloudvault/worker && npm run build -w @cloudvault/web
